notes.title: Demo Reactivation
notes.notes:
Legendary Survivors demo has been reactivated. I reworked on a lot of things so it should play much better now.

What's new:
-The game now has a darker theme.
-A hub where you can preview some of the new characters that will be in the game later.
-Half of the perks are now picked up automatically to minimize disruption in the game play.
-Keyboard users can rebind their keys.
-Health bar for minions and monsters.

Skills
-The combat is now a bit more hack and slash oriented.
-Couple of new slashes.
-New range attacks using a bow. Player can swap between melee and range mode or set it to auto.
-Archer and wolf summon with improved AI.

Bosses
-3 new bosses with a distinctive ability.

Meta upgrades will be added later. Join the discord the server to keep up with the updates.
